acceptance_checks.description: Every landed file in the volume is byte-identical (sha256) to the legacy-archived original; no size-compared-twice 'settle' heuristic — atomic Files API PUT only.
ow_tp.bronze.custbill_raw_files has exactly one row per landed file with ns, file_name, byte_count, sha256, landed_at; counts reconcile with the volume listing.
Reruns are idempotent with no lock files; a rerun re-registers nothing and duplicates nothing.
No hostname if-blocks; all paths derive from ns + volume root parameters.

planted_anomalies.description: Parent re-lands an already-registered file byte-identically during live validation; the job must not create a second registry row (idempotent skip, attributed in run output).

planted_anomalies.reason: The legacy in-flight/half-written SFTP transfer race cannot be reproduced through the Files API transport, which is atomic per PUT; the deficiency is retired by construction rather than detected.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Ingest is byte-transparent end-to-end: files are moved and checksummed as opaque bytes, never decoded. EBCDIC-adjacent or invalid-UTF8 bytes must not fail ingest.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: pass-through untouched; decoding is the parser's concern

malformed_record_policy.details: Ingest does not inspect records; 'records' are not parsed here. A file with a NULL/empty name or zero-byte body must fail loudly, never be registered as a plausible-looking row.

empty_input_semantics.details: A run with no new files in the landing drop leaves the registry and volume untouched and exits success (legacy behavior: poll finds nothing, exits 0).
